title: Create Invoice reached before the page knew about the hold is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, open the Finance tab.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  4. Change Credit Terms to Credit Hold.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Switch to the first tab.
  7. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Create Invoice is enabled.

Step 2:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 3:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 4:

  • Credit Terms shows Credit Hold.

Step 5:

  • Customer B is saved on Credit Hold.

Step 6:

  • The first tab still shows Create Invoice enabled.

Step 7:

  • An error toast shows "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer B's name], is on Credit Hold"
  • The toast has a "Change Bill To" button.
  • No invoice is created: the Finance tab lists no invoice after a reload.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R9: “If Create Invoice is reached anyway or the server refuses it, M2 shows as an error toast with a "Change Bill To" button, and no invoice is created.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M2 | Create Invoice when the Bill To is on Credit Hold | "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [Bill To], is on Credit Hold" | Banner with "Change Bill To"; Create Invoice tooltip; error toast with "Change Bill To"”
  • Key Decisions: “The Bill To's Credit Hold blocks invoicing, checked on the server; its credit limit warns but never blocks.”
